def self.deliver(url, body)
    uri = URI(url)
    http = Net::HTTP.new(uri.host, uri.port)
    http.use_ssl = true
    http.verify_mode = OpenSSL::SSL::VERIFY_NONE
    http.post(uri.request_uri, body, 'Content-Type' => 'application/json').code.to_i

plan.reason: Whether the client refuses an untrusted certificate is a TLS handshake property: it needs a TLS peer presenting an untrusted certificate and a network connection observation, and the environment lists neither
